native_admission_diagnosis.purpose: Preserved diagnostic baseline/v4/v5 raw traces identify missing generic native-entry counts; same19/29-op callee bodies and restored2-site88-op caller splice. Timings are excluded from acceptance. Later revisions also count committed cache fills and defer the prepared-entry check until an existing pure retry checkpoint is due.

phase0_policy: Seven baseline runs per fixture establish MAD; threshold=max(3%,2.5*MAD/median). Final comparison requires median slowdown above this threshold and paired-bootstrap95%interval excludes parity in slower direction. Raw loop milliseconds are the primary component; process wall/CPU/RSS retained separately.
